title: Call 03: Out-of-Scope Query & Human Specialist Escalation
description: Customer Sarah asks an out-of-scope query regarding pet insurance vaccination schedules. Agent delivers safe anti-hallucination fallback. Customer requests immediate human specialist transfer.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hello! Thank you for calling HealthShield. My name is Aria, your HealthShield AI assistant. This call may be recorded for quality assurance. I'm here to help you explore our health insurance plans. May I ask your name, please?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hello, my name is Sarah Jenkins

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Lovely to meet you, Sarah Jenkins! To help find the right HealthShield plan for you, could I ask how old you are?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Perfect, thank you! At 29, you're eligible for all our main plan tiers. Do you currently have any pre-existing medical conditions, such as diabetes, hypertension, or heart disease?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, I have no pre-existing conditions

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Got it, thank you for sharing that. What kind of coverage are you most interested in? For example, hospitalization, outpatient care, maternity, or a comprehensive plan?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I'm interested in individual comprehensive coverage

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Excellent! Based on what you've told me, here's what I found in our verified policy records: HealthShield Plan Tiers & Coverage Benefits Would you like to know more about a specific plan, or do you have any questions?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: What is the pet insurance vaccination schedule for Golden Retrievers?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, I don't have verified information on that specific topic in our policy records. I wouldn't want to give you inaccurate details. Would you like me to connect you with one of our licensed specialists who can look that up for you, or shall we return to our health plans?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I need to speak to a licensed human specialist right away, please transfer me to your supervisor.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Of course! Let me connect you with one of our licensed human specialists right away. They'll be able to assist you fully. Please hold on briefly.
